capabilities: Record microphone and Mac system audio from within the current note
Transcribe recordings locally with whisper.cpp and label speakers as Me/Others
Generate titles, summaries and action-item checklists with local Ollama models
Create custom summary templates with a name, purpose and prompt
Mute or pause individual audio tracks mid-recording from a floating bar
extras: Desktop macOS 13+ only; uses Node.js filesystem and shell execution that Obsidian's plugin review flags, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT; release assets carry GitHub build-provenance attestations.
motivation: The author built it because meeting tools upload conversations to someone else's servers, and Echostrata keeps everything on the Mac.
problem: Obsidian's audio recorder only embeds recordings, and meeting tools upload conversations to cloud servers; there is no local in-note transcription and summarisation.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Lecture Transcriber by AbyssLotus.
Speech recognition: whisper.cpp by Georgi Gerganov, using OpenAI's Whisper models.
Optional loopback driver: BlackHole by Existential Audio.

summary: macOS in-note recorder that captures mic and system audio, then writes a local whisper.cpp transcript and an Ollama-generated summary into the note.
